## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md or docs/DECISIONS.md updated if a choice was made

- [ ] No secrets committed, no personal data in logs
- [ ] UI changes have loading, empty, error and phone states
